name: TensorPM v1.42.2
body:
# Changelog - v1.42.2

This update makes the timeline smooth again, stops sync conflicts that appeared and vanished on
their own after almost every save, and tidies up how menus look.

## 🗓️ Timeline

- **Moving a bar no longer stutters:** dragging or resizing a bar, giving an undated task or work
  package a span, applying a schedule fix or removing a span now saves only the changed dates.
  Before, every change saved the whole project and the timeline paused for one to three seconds.
- If such a change can't be saved, the bar returns to its saved dates, even after several quick
  moves in a row.

## 🔄 Sync

- **No more phantom conflicts:** after a conflict on a task, work package or other record had been
  settled once, every later change to that record showed up as a new conflict and then resolved
  itself a moment later. Changes are now sent normally. Real conflicts, where someone else changed
  the same record in the meantime, are still shown as before.

## 🎨 Cleaner Menus

- **Menus highlight whole rows:** in context menus and dropdowns (tasks, people, files, the
  account menu, assignee and model pickers), the entry under the pointer is now highlighted as a
  clean, full-width row instead of a rounded pill or a half-rounded shape. All other buttons look
  as before.
- The **back link in the account menu** (for example "‹ Workspaces") is now a plain title with an
  arrow instead of a framed button.

---

## 📅 Release Info

- **Version**: 1.42.2
- **Release Date**: 2026-10-05
- **Previous Version**: 1.42.1
- **Type**: Patch Release
